composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create an original forty-year-old adult in a plum quilted jacket. Show broad quilted sections rather than many tiny stitched squares. The jacket is fully zipped below the chin, and the hood frames the shoulders without enclosing the face. Render short textured hair, natural smile lines, and calm eyes. Cool background light catches the fabric edges while warm light keeps the face readable. Use detailed textile fashion illustration. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
